        Advanced rarely needed
        

            The desk ID is looked up from the desk name on every run, so leave it empty. Set it
            only to pin a specific desk when the lookup cannot find one by name.
        

        

            
            
        

        

            
            
        

        

            The API contract lives here as JSON so you can correct it without rebuilding the
            extension. Placeholders: {{date}}, {{deskId}},
            {{deskName}}, {{slot}}, {{startTime}},
            {{endTime}}, {{from}}, {{to}},
            {{userId}}, {{floorId}}, {{buildingId}},
            {{areaId}}.
        

        
    


    

        Diagnostics you should not need this
        

            Normal use needs nothing in here. This is for when the endpoint config is wrong and
            someone has to find the real API — a one-time job for one person, not a setup step.
